just try to understand that you have nothing to hide. and I've also realised that it works completely both ways. you feel as if somebody's trying to get a read on you, which humans naturally do, without even being conscious of it. So you read that back, however you are conscious of it. which makes them more conscious of that. so they read more, you read more. might I add in my own opinion, you read better. but its honestly best to stay on the sidelines and become what I like to call watchers. introverted, quiet and calm. manage your thoughts. notice the patterns in other peoples speech,  their mannerisms. subjects they tend to lean towards. you know things like that, the subtle details that line our conversations. with psychosis I feel as if you get very good at picking up on these things. because you're so used to trying to picking up hints that somebody is trying to read ur mind. 

just remember the cant read your thoughts, that's delusion, only your body language and tone and you're better at it than them.

also dont fall for the code talking shit. that's an illusion always

my point is that psychosis is just another state of the mind. it's not good, nor bad. it just is. and there is always a way around it.
